about: The 214 Kangxi radicals, with their other shapes, the HSK 1 characters each one appears in ("main" = it is the character's dictionary radical), and up to 10 other common characters containing it.
sources: Radical list and numbering: the Kangxi radicals (Unicode Kangxi Radicals block; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kangxi_radicals).
Character parts, pinyin and dictionary radicals: Make Me a Hanzi dictionary.txt (github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi, LGPL).
How common a character is: jieba dict.txt (github.com/fxsjy/jieba, MIT).
Side forms and everyday radical names: written by Claude from standard references.
